scope: Independent preliminary probes; not production integration or human observations
production_gate: ZG-001 / G0 still blocked on actual v1.2.1 source recovery

residual_counterexample.interpretation: Exact residual identity can conceal unusable retuning; not a tested real tracker

band_identity.limitation: Whole-file noncausal filtering; not chunk/causal equivalence or listening evidence

comb_density.limitation: Target-density bias in an artificial null, not measured chord perception

oversampling_example.limitation: Waveform residual, not pure alias energy or preference

phrase_model.limitation: Generator distributions, not human uncertainty; no rendered matched stimuli

statistical_simulation.limitation: Simulated contrast units; both approximations remain miscalibrated here; no universal participant count

reference_audit.method: 24 kHz stereo power; 2048/256 Hann; 20..10000 Hz; per-file top RMS quartile
reference_audit.limitation: Observational unequal mastered arrangements, not corresponding motifs until reviewed; no source audio published

publication: Scripts and summary committed on research branch; full local snapshot and detailed notes require repository-manifest verification before claiming complete raw-data publication
